beats.caption: 10 runs, 5 scenarios, 4 strategies. Unplanned failures drop from 32 to 1 compared with the best alarm setup. In normal flying, readiness stays about the same.
Every strategy faces the same 90 days and the same events. In normal flying, readiness is about the same, with 31 fewer unplanned failures.
Turn off spares awareness and more aircraft look ready, but failures jump from 1.2 to 15.7. The other 2 parts made no measurable difference here.
